name: the rule: next state
note: The position after a move (the units moved, the castling rook placed, the pawn taken en passant lifted, the rights lost, the e.p. square set after a double push, the clock): the spec's next state is a function and is the kernel's Chess.applyMove on every position for every pseudo-legal move (Ideas.NextEquiv, plan 76.1 (b)).
